Submission: October 27, 2025

docs.title: Introduction
docs.text: • This is the individual website the research, design and development of the Alarm Subsystem in the Smart Door Sensor.

docs.title: Project Summary
docs.text:
• Smart Door Sensor designed to be capable of detection to determine if door is locked, auto-lock and unlock operations, number pad input for added security, and analarm system to notify users of any issues to be resolved.
  • Project research, design and development documented on the team website.

docs.title: Product Objective and Requirements
docs.text: This project aims to investigate and develop smart adaptive technologies, an improved user experience, better fit, improved product design, and product customization options for the next-generation of home door sensors. This subsystem fulfils requirements stated in Section 2.2 of the team product requirements "The product shall send real-time alerts for door left open, forced entry attempts, and lock tampering".

1. CE-2808B36 Round Micro Speaker

    • $0.85/each

    Pros Cons Inexpensive Smaller Frequency Range

  2. SP-4005Y Dynamic Speaker Unit

    • $2/each
    • Link to product
    Pros Cons Higher Efficiency Smaller Frequency Range

  3. AST-02308MR-R General Purpose Speaker

    • $3.36/each
    • Link to product
    Pros Cons Higher Frequency Range Expensive

Choice: Option 2: SP-4005Y Dynamic Speaker Unit

Rationale: This Speaker has a high efficiency while keeping a relatively low price. Hence, it can provide louder and clearer sounds even off a low powered setup like the system we intend to build.

docs.title: Switches
docs.text:
1. R4ABLKBLKFF0 Rocker Switch

    • $1.39/each
    • link to product
    Pros Cons More durable than other options High Voltage Rating

  2. ESE-20D441 PushButton Switch

    • $0.88/each
    • Link to product
    Pros Cons Inexpensive Pushbuttons may be easy to miss or break in emergency situations

  3. CST10T2CR Relay Switch

    • $2.65/each
    • Link to product
    Pros Cons Relay System Expensive

Choice: Option 3: CST10T2CR Relay Switch

Rationale: This Relay system built into the switch would allow to control appliances with low power signals. This can be useful in protecting against high voltage passes and other hazardous conditions by safely switching circuits off to prevent damage.

docs.title: Op-Amp
docs.text:
1. LM358ADR Op Amp

    • $0.2/each
    • link to product
    Pros Cons InExpensive Output not Rail to Rail

  2. MCP6004-I/P Op Amp

    • $0.6/each
    • Link to product
    Pros Cons 4 Op-Amp Circuits Expensive

  3. MCP6006UT-E/OT Op Amp

    • $0.2/each
    • Link to product
    Pros Cons High Operating Temperature 2 Circuit

Choice: Option 2: MCP6004-I/P Op Amp

Rationale: This Op-Amp provides 4 Circuits that can be used all on one supply voltage. It is also already available to the team and hence has no cost.

docs.title: 5V Regulator
docs.text:
1. AS78L05RTR-E1 Regulator

    • $0.12/each
    • link to product
    Pros Cons InExpensive Lower Max Input Voltage

  2. AP7375-50SA-7 Regulator

    • $0.25/each
    • Link to product
    Pros Cons Current Limit Control Feauture Larger Voltage Dropoff

  3. Custom Made Regulator

    • $0.0/each
    Pros Cons InExpensive No Proper Documentation

Choice: Option 2: Custom Made Regulator

Rationale: This Regulator offer customization on impedance and fuse ratings hence allowing for current control to protect lower rated components on the circuit and output control allowing for any voltage need by the components.

docs.title: Microphone
docs.text:
1. CMEJ-4618-42-LX Electric Condenser Microphone

    • $0.83/each
    • link to product
    Pros Cons Inexpensive Smaller Frequency Range

  2. AOM-4544P-2-R Omni-Directional Microphone

    • $1/each
    • Link to product
    Pros Cons Stable frequency response Pin Type Mounting(Requires special connection)

  3. PMOF-9745W-42DQ Analog Microphone Electret Condenser

    • $1.82/each
    • Link to product
    Pros Cons Higher Sensitivity Range for low profile environments Lower Signal to Noise ratio.

Choice: Option 2: AOM-4544P-2-R Omni-Directional Microphone

Rationale: This microphone is the better choice because it sits within the middle of the sensitivity range, price, and Signal to Noise rato of the other two microphones. Coupled with its stable frequency reducing the need for a filter, this microphone is the obvious choice.
